verdict.rationale: Increase documents its account model: an Account is separate from Account Numbers, with one-to-many mapping and unique numbers per counterparty. A customer story mentions creating FBO accounts, and FDIC insurance is referenced via IntraFi network sweeps; a community note says accounts are actually held at First Internet Bank or Blue Ridge Bank. However, nothing plainly explains whether funds are pooled in FBO accounts or held individually, where FDIC coverage attaches (pass-through or per-depositor), or who can view the ledger. Missing for 10: plain documentation of FBO vs individual account structure, explicit FDIC pass-through/attachment rules, ledger visibility and access documentation, first-party disclosure of partner banks.
